title: A translation memory shard (data/i18n/tm/<culture>/<2 hex>.json)
description: translator@PrompTugal.dinis, to board/spec-translations.md item 3: an object keyed by the first 16 hex of the sha256 of the normalised English segment; each entry holds the translation, who and which model made it, when, the first 60 characters of the English, and ok (a second pass confirmed it).
